sections.section_name: Section D - Application and Problem Solving

questions.question_text: Rani goes to a stationery shop. She buys an eraser for ₹4 and a sharpener for ₹5. She gives a ₹10 note to the shopkeeper. How much money did Rani spend in total? How much change will the shopkeeper return to her?
questions.answer: Step 1: Total money spent = ₹4 (eraser) + ₹5 (sharpener) = ₹9. Step 2: Change received = ₹10 - ₹9 = ₹1. Rani spent ₹9 and got ₹1 back.

questions.question_text: Look at the basket of fruits: 3 Mangoes, 5 Bananas, and 2 Apples. Answer the following: a) How many fruits are there in total? b) Which fruit is the most in number? c) Which fruit is the least in number?
questions.answer: a) Total fruits = 3 + 5 + 2 = 10 fruits. b) Bananas are the most (5). c) Apples are the least (2).
